title.narrative: Electricity Sector Modernization and Sustainability Project

description.narrative: The Project aims to improve the operational efficiency and reliability of the electricity sector in a multi-dimensional manner – proven loss reduction methods through advanced metering infrastructure; modernization of the distribution network and its operations; and introduction of digital tools for operations and commercial activities. The financial performance is expected to improve with adherence to a tariff trajectory towards cost recovery and improved efficiency in service delivery and the institutional performance will be improved through capacity-building at the national and corporate level. The social protection systems will be strengthened through technical assistance and capacity building to better protect the vulnerable population who might be negatively impacted by tariff increases. The project will also contribute to the energy sector transparency and financial discipline through technical assistance and capacity building on improved sector and corporate governance practices.
To improve the financial performance and operational reliability of the electricity sector.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I. A. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall establish, no later than two (2) months from theEffective Date, and thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period, a Steering Committee, with composition andterms of reference further detailed in the POM, to be responsible for facilitating coordination between involved agencies andproviding overall strategic and policy guidance.

Schedule 2, Section I. B. 1. of the Financing Agreement: To facilitate the carrying out of the Project, the Recipient, through MoE,shall enter into agreements with the Distribution Companies, under terms and conditions satisfactory to the Association (“AssetTransfer Agreements”) which include, inter alia, the commitment of the Recipient to transfer the assets procured for Part 1 and 2of the Project with the proceeds of the Financing to the respective Distribution Company.

Schedule 2, Section I. C. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through MOE, shall adopt the Project Operations Manual(“POM”), in a manner satisfactory to the Association, and shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordance with the POM,setting forth rules, methods, guidelines, and procedures for the carrying out of the Project, including, inter alia: (a) detaileddescription of Project and institutional arrangements for implementing the Project; (b) selection criteria and eligibilitycriteria and procedures for of the selection of Sub-projects under Part 1 of the Project; (c) monitoring, evaluation, reporting,and governance procedures for the Project; (d) the Verification Protocol; and (e) overall disbursement, financial management,auditing and procurement procedures for the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I. E. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordancewith the Environmental and Social Standards, in a manner acceptable to the Association.

Project net greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions are calculated as an annual average of the difference between project gross (absolute) emissions aggregated over the economic lifetime of the project and the emissions of a baseline (counterfactual) scenario aggregated over the same time horizon. They are reported in metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent per year. As physical investments were made not long ago, it needs at least six months to see the impact on electricity loss reduction which will be used to estimate GHG reduction. Initial data is expected in the next ISR.
